source.job: Amu selfhost and Kotoba CLI requests
source.gate: Kotoba SQLite image publication, readback and sidecar refusals (native ARM64)

nativeResult.behavior: Kotoba deleted one key from the exact two-leaf roots, rebuilt both leaf pages, FS2-published/reopened the seven-row image, and verified the removed and preserved values through Kotoba.

scope: This qualifies one key deletion leaving seven rows on the exact two-leaf table/index image on Linux ARM64. It does not qualify arbitrary multi-row deletion, deeper roots, general SQLite layouts, WAL/recovery, standard SQLite locking, crash consistency, Linux x86_64, or Itonami integration.
